{"consolidated_memory":"**Leaked Field in platform/logging/redact.go — Two Separate Incidents**

Both incidents involved the same problem location (platform/logging/redact.go, same corner as prior leaked field work) but different underlying causes and triggers.

**Incident 1: Clock Skew via Corporate Proxy [2026-03-22]**
- Signal: Value that should have been masked appeared in log line
- Trigger: Only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR: #2335 on branch fix/leaked-field-1
- Repro: Log the nested payload fixture
- Outcome: Throughput rose 35 percent, reaching 778 requests per second

**Incident 2: Unwrapped Transaction Writes [2026-07-13]**
- Signal: Value that should have been masked appeared in log line
- Trigger: Only manifested on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #7992 on branch fix/leaked-field-2
- Repro: Log the nested payload fixture
- Outcome: The backlog cleared 3 minutes after the deploy

Both incidents affected the same code region in platform/logging/redact.go on the platform side. Different fixes were deployed 3.5 months apart."}
